structured_vibe_prompt.role: A 线 C/C++ shared_ptr_race 开发负责人
structured_vibe_prompt.sustained_goal: 仅在来源证明的生产级同对象未同步并发 root 漏检时改进 shared_ptr_race；将语法候选与真实并发根因分开，并保持 A0 状态和精确源码身份可复核。
steps: 对 A0 每条候选绑定 commit/tree/blob/SHA 并独立重跑当前生产 CLI。
逐个对象追踪 shared_ptr 读写、对象共享方式、线程/信号/task 生命周期以及 mutex/atomic/condition-variable 同步。
区分初始化后只读、互斥保护、线程局部/单次任务生命周期和真实跨线程重叠。
仅在确认生产可达同一 shared_ptr wrapper 未同步读写时改规则；补正例、修复/安全/无关/改名/partial controls 并交由独立测试线复验。
对证据不足的项保留 PARTIAL/BLOCK 并列明最小缺失证据。
structured_vibe_prompt.completion_gate: 精确源码 CLI 回放与独立来源身份验证通过；适用产品级 root 漏检有同对象跨线程未同步访问证据；修复和安全对照按证据能力验证；范围检查无违规。
boundaries: 不得将 shared_ptr 语法候选等同于 data race。
不得按 CVE、仓库、符号名或哈希硬编码。
不得修改 A0 queue 状态或推断产品构建、攻击可达性和影响。

source_review.disposition: No detector change. No source-proven production-level missed root cause was established. Keep PARTIAL; the report did not prove safety or false positives.
findings: CR-0119–CR-0123: fp_backtrace.cpp FpBacktraceImpl::maps_ is assigned by Init before CreateInstance returns. SymbolicAddress serializes cachedFrames_ with mutex_; no maps_ write after publication is shown. Cross-thread use of a returned instance is not bound by the source evidence.

CR-0124–CR-0142: mostly shared_ptr constructor/member-use lines in stack/unwind parser objects. Exact line replay did not emit candidates for these 19 A0 locations; scoped CLI parsed all selected files completely. Their code uses inputs/member pointers during parsing, but source rows alone establish no shared concurrently mutated wrapper.

CR-0143: LocalThreadContextMix::SetMaps writes singleton maps_ without a lock; production references found in this snapshot do not call SetMaps (only test call sites). Production CollectThreadContext assigns maps_ before signal request and ReleaseCollectThreadContext resets under mtx_ after wait; signal callback readers use maps_. Concurrent CollectThreadContext callers / external scheduling are not proven impossible, so lifecycle serialization remains unknown. Keep this as unresolved synchronization obligation, not confirmed race or proven safe.

CR-0144–CR-0156: candidate lines are ctor/method uses across DfxAccessorsCustomize, ElfParser, DwarfCfaInstructions/DwarfOp, UnwindEntryParser, and UnwinderBase. Current scanner emitted no exact-line finding for these A0 locations; ownership and call/thread overlap are not established by syntax.

CR-0157–CR-0160: keyRegs_, keyThread_, regs_ setters/accessors in process-dump data objects. Writers occur during initialization/request assembly; fields are later read for formatting/submission. Component source does not establish a concurrent writer/read on the same DfxProcess/segment-writer object. No consistent mutex/atomic protects these fields, but a race is not implied absent overlap. Product invocation/concurrency profile remains unknown.
